question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**transpiration**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**transpiration**" refers to **the process by which water is absorbed by plants and then released into the atmosphere as water vapour.** (वाष्पोत्सर्जन)
 
• In the context of the water cycle, after precipitation falls onto the land, some water is taken up by plants and released back into the atmosphere **through transpiration.**
 
• The other options "**condensation**", "**evaporation**", and "**precipitation**" refer to different stages of the water cycle and do not fit the context of water being taken up by plants.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Some of it may evaporate back into the air, while some may be taken up by plants and released back into the atmosphere through a process called transpiration__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Condensation (संघनन)**: the process by which water vapour in the air is changed into liquid water.
 
• **Evaporation (वाष्पीकरण)**: the process by which water turns into vapour.
 
• **Precipitation (वृष्टि)**: the action of releasing moisture from clouds, which falls to the ground as rain, snow, sleet, or hail.
